name: Build: Noise Box summons its device instead of nothing
contract: Build: Noise Box 280310 is SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON with EffectMiscValue[0] = 280311, a creature entry that has no
creature_template row anywhere in data/sql. Spell::EffectSummonType silently no-ops when the template lookup
fails, so the cooldown fires and nothing spawns. Entry 52036 ('Noise Box') already has a creature_template row
already periodically casts 561269 on nearby enemies for that exact entry. A GlobalScript correction retargets
280310's summon effect to 52036 at load time. Expected: casting it spawns a 52036 device near the caster

steps.label: The Noise Box device spawns (entry 52036, not the missing 280311)
The device is still alive and owned after settling into its periodic AI
